maudhui: (1) All legislative power over all matters concerning Mainland Tanzania shall be vested in Parliament. (2) Legislative power in Tanzania Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters shall be vested in the House of Representatives. (3) Where any law enacted by the House of Representatives concerns any matter in Tanzania Zanzibar which is within the jurisdiction of Parliament, that law shall be null and void. (4) Any law enacted by Parliament concerning any matter shall not apply to Tanzania Zanzibar except in accordance with the following provisions: (a) that law expressly provides that it shall apply to Mainland Tanzania as well as Tanzania Zanzibar; or (b) that law amends, modifies or repeals a law which is in force in Tanzania Zanzibar; or (c) that law relates to Union Matters. (5) Without prejudice to the application of the Constitution of Zanzibar, this Constitution shall have the force of law throughout the United Republic and, where any other law is inconsistent with the provisions contained in this Constitution, the Constitution shall prevail.
